title: Amazon Blocks Meta's Muse AI Agent from Scraping Its Site
summary: Amazon has blocked Meta's new AI agent, Muse, from accessing and scraping its website. The move highlights growing tensions between major tech platforms over data access and AI training resources.
point1: Amazon has restricted Meta's Muse AI agent from using Amazon.com.
point2: The block reflects a broader industry trend of platforms protecting their proprietary data from rival AI models.

title: Tamil Nadu CM Vijay Launches Expanded Breakfast Scheme for Government Schools
summary: Tamil Nadu Chief Minister Vijay has launched the expanded Perunthalaivar Kamarajar Breakfast Scheme, extending free meals to government school students. The expansion is set to benefit approximately 15.3 lakh students in Classes VI to VIII across 15,454 schools.
point1: The breakfast scheme has been expanded to cover students in Classes VI to VIII.
point2: The expansion will benefit over 15.3 lakh students in more than 15,000 government and government-aided schools.

title: Money View Files to Raise ₹1,092 Crore Through IPO
summary: Indian financial technology startup Money View is planning to raise ₹1,092 crore through an initial public offering (IPO). The company has filed its draft papers for the public listing.
point1: Money View is launching an IPO to raise ₹1,092 crore.
point2: The move represents a major public market debut for a prominent Indian fintech firm.

title: ED Files Chargesheet Against EaseMyTrip Promoter in Mahadev Betting Case
summary: India's Enforcement Directorate has filed a chargesheet against EaseMyTrip promoter Nishant Pitti in connection with the Mahadev betting app case. The agency alleges that Pitti entered into a pre-arranged stock manipulation deal to artificially inflate the share price of Easy Trip Planners Ltd.
point1: The Enforcement Directorate has charged EaseMyTrip promoter Nishant Pitti.
point2: The chargesheet alleges a stock price manipulation deal to artificially inflate market capitalization.

title: Cisco Talos Detects Autonomous Malware Guided by AI Hive Mind
summary: Researchers at Cisco Talos have developed a new framework to identify hacking tools and malware that utilize AI chatbots. During their research, they discovered an unusual autonomous command system where malware is guided by an AI hive mind without human intervention.
point1: Cisco Talos developed a framework to track AI-integrated malware.
point2: The tool uncovered an autonomous command system guided entirely by an AI hive mind.

title: Canadian Province Sues OpenAI Over Tumbler Ridge School Shooting
summary: The Canadian province of British Columbia has filed a lawsuit against OpenAI. The province accuses the artificial intelligence company of failing to report a school shooter's troubling interactions with ChatGPT to law enforcement.
point1: British Columbia is suing OpenAI over a school shooting in Tumbler Ridge.
point2: The lawsuit alleges OpenAI failed to report the shooter's dangerous ChatGPT interactions to police.

title: US Media Outlets Boycott Shared Trump Coverage Over White House Ban
summary: Major United States news organizations have boycotted shared pool coverage of President Donald Trump. The protest was launched after the administration banned CNN, MS NOW, and Politico from accessing the White House.
point1: Major US media outlets are boycotting shared coverage of the president.
point2: The boycott is a direct protest against the White House banning CNN, MS NOW, and Politico.

title: External Affairs Minister Jaishankar Calls for Reformed Multilateralism at UN Summit
summary: Addressing the P4M Summit in New York, External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar urged international leaders to reinforce and reform multilateralism. He stated that global institutions require modernization to effectively manage contemporary geopolitical conflicts.
point1: S. Jaishankar called for structural reforms to global multilateral institutions during his address in New York.
point2: Reiterates India's foreign policy initiative seeking greater representation for developing nations in global decision-making.

title: Two Infants Die in Hospital SNCU Ward Fire in Telangana
summary: A fire broke out in the Special Newborn Care Unit at the RIMS hospital in Adilabad, Telangana, killing two infants. Rescue personnel safely evacuated 25 other children from the ward, and the Chief Minister ordered a formal inquiry into the incident.
point1: Two infants lost their lives following a fire at the RIMS Adilabad hospital ward in Telangana.
point2: Led to immediate state government orders for safety reviews and a inquiry into public medical facilities.

title: G7 Demands Iran Halt Arms Shipments to Houthis Ahead of UN Assembly
summary: G7 foreign ministers issued a collective statement urging Iran to immediately stop supplying weapons to Houthi forces in Yemen. The G7 strongly condemned Houthi strikes on Saudi Arabia, warning that escalated hostilities threaten global energy security.
point1: G7 foreign ministers demanded Iran end military weapons transfers to Houthi rebels in Yemen.
point2: Reflects coordinated diplomatic pressure to defend global shipping routes and energy security ahead of the UN summit.

title: Meta’s AI Agent Muse Outpaces ChatGPT’s Early Mobile Launch Growth
summary: Meta's new mobile AI agent, Muse, has accumulated more downloads and daily active users in the U.S. and Canada than ChatGPT did during its initial post-launch window. The figures stem from app intelligence estimates released by Appfigures.
point1: Meta's Muse mobile agent recorded higher early download and user activity metrics in North America than ChatGPT did at launch.
point2: Highlights accelerating user adoption trends for integrated mobile AI assistant platforms.

title: Google debuts $899 Googlebook laptop built around Gemini AI
summary: Google introduced the $899 Googlebook, an AI-native laptop engineered to integrate deeply with its Gemini AI model. The device connects Gemini directly to desktop widgets, dictation features, and cursor controls while offering seamless interaction with Android devices.
point1: Google launched the $899 Googlebook laptop with hardware-level integration for its Gemini AI system.
point2: The laptop aims to provide Android users with integrated desktop and artificial intelligence features.

title: Escalating Yemen conflict forces refugees to flee across Red Sea to Djibouti
summary: Intensifying military clashes between Houthi forces and Saudi-backed troops have triggered widespread civilian displacement in Yemen. Large numbers of displaced residents are attempting maritime crossings across the Red Sea to reach Djibouti.
point1: Escalated fighting in Yemen led to displaced civilians crossing the Red Sea into Djibouti.
point2: The humanitarian crisis intensifies as combat surges between Houthi fighters and Saudi-backed troops.

title: Supreme Court Orders Fresh Investigation Into 2012 Dharmasthala Rape-Murder Case
summary: The Supreme Court of India has ordered a fresh investigation into the 2012 rape and murder of a woman near Dharmasthala in Karnataka. The court directed the state to form a new, tech-savvy Special Investigation Team (SIT) excluding any officers from the previous investigation.
point1: The Supreme Court ordered a fresh probe by a newly constituted SIT.
point2: The lone accused in the 2012 case was previously acquitted by a CBI court in 2023.
point3: The SIT is directed to complete the investigation within three months.

title: Maharashtra Likely to Declare 100% Drought by End of September
summary: Maharashtra Cooperation Minister Babasaheb Patil announced that a 100% drought is likely to be declared across the state by the end of September due to an unprecedented dry spell. The state government has already initiated relief measures, including student fee waivers and water tanker deployments.
point1: Cooperation Minister Babasaheb Patil stated a full drought declaration is expected by the end of September.
point2: The state has initiated relief measures such as student fee waivers, electricity bill waivers, and water tankers.
point3: The drought declaration is expected to be finalized by the end of September 2026.

title: National Stock Exchange of India IPO Subscribed Nearly Six Times
summary: The National Stock Exchange of India (NSE) initial public offering has attracted nearly ₹90,300 crore in demand, achieving a subscription rate of 5.71 times. According to BSE data, the IPO received bids for 50.58 crore shares against the 8.86 crore shares on offer.
point1: The NSE IPO was subscribed 5.71 times, receiving bids for over 50.58 crore shares.
point2: The offering generated approximately ₹90,300 crore in total demand.

title: X to Notify Users When Governments Force Post Restrictions
summary: Social media platform X is expanding its "Under the Hood" transparency tool to inform users when their posts have been downranked or withheld. The notifications will specify which country made the request in response to local laws or government demands.
point1: X will notify users if their posts are downranked or withheld due to government demands.
point2: The transparency tool will disclose which specific country requested the restriction.

title: Kairos Power Secures $100 Million From Samsung Group for Google Nuclear Project
summary: Google's future energy supplier, Kairos Power, has signed an agreement with Samsung C&T to secure up to $100 million in funding. The investment will support the construction of Kairos Power's first 50-megawatt nuclear power plant.
point1: Samsung C&T is investing up to $100 million in Kairos Power.
point2: The funding will help build a 50-megawatt nuclear power plant to supply energy to Google.

title: Google Launches $899 Googlebook Laptop Integrated With Gemini AI
summary: Google has introduced the Googlebook, an $899 AI-native laptop designed to deeply integrate its Gemini AI assistant into the desktop experience. The device aims to provide Android users with seamless connectivity similar to the integration between iPhones and Macs.
point1: The Googlebook is priced at $899 and features deep integration with Gemini AI.
point2: The laptop is designed to offer seamless connectivity for Android phone users.

title: OpenAI Forms Math Advisory Group as AI Resolves Over 100 Open Problems
summary: OpenAI has established a math advisory group following achievements where its AI models resolved more than 100 open mathematical problems. The advisory group will not have the authority to slow down or redirect OpenAI's ongoing mathematical research.
point1: OpenAI's AI has successfully resolved more than 100 open mathematical problems.
point2: The new advisory group is restricted from redirecting or slowing down OpenAI's mathematical research.

title: Millions Urged to Evacuate as Typhoon Dujuan Strikes Japan
summary: Millions of residents in Japan were urged to evacuate as Typhoon Dujuan made landfall. The country's meteorological agency initially warned of an imminent threat to life before downgrading the alert level.
point1: Japanese authorities urged millions of people to evacuate due to the storm.
point2: The meteorological agency initially issued its highest warning level before downgrading it.

title: Google Fined €403 Million by Irish Data Watchdog Over GDPR Violations
summary: Ireland's Data Protection Commission has imposed a €403 million fine on Google following a six-year investigation into GDPR violations. The inquiry was originally launched after complaints from several European consumer rights organizations.
point1: The Irish data watchdog fined Google €403 million.
point2: The penalty stems from a six-year inquiry into GDPR violations initiated by European consumer rights groups.

title: India-New Zealand Free Trade Agreement Ratified to Take Effect in October
summary: The bilateral Free Trade Agreement (FTA) between India and New Zealand has been ratified and will officially enter into force on October 20. Under the agreement, New Zealand will eliminate all tariffs on Indian imports, while India will reduce or remove tariffs on 95% of current imports from New Zealand.
point1: The India-New Zealand FTA has been ratified by both nations.
point2: New Zealand will remove all tariffs on Indian imports, while India will remove or reduce tariffs on 95% of imports from New Zealand.
point3: The agreement will officially come into force on October 20, 2026.

title: FSSAI Initiates Legal Action Against Nestle India Over Infant Nutrition Claims
summary: The Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) has initiated legal action against Nestle India over its infant nutrition products. The regulator has sought clarifications from the company regarding claims made about '5HMOs' and 'Whey Protein.'
point1: FSSAI has launched legal action against Nestle India regarding its infant nutrition products.
point2: The regulator is questioning claims made by the company regarding '5HMOs' and 'Whey Protein.'

title: India and Canada to Hold Next Round of Trade Pact Talks in October
summary: India and Canada are scheduled to hold their next round of negotiations for a proposed trade pact starting October 5. The announcement follows the conclusion of the fourth round of talks in New Delhi on September 18.
point1: The next round of bilateral trade negotiations is scheduled to begin on October 5.
point2: The talks aim to establish a proposed trade pact between the two nations.

title: Groundwater Crisis in Punjab Widens Social and Economic Divide
summary: A new study has found that the groundwater crisis in Punjab is widening social and economic divides. Punjab has the highest percentage of over-exploited groundwater blocks in India at 76.47%, driven by heavy cultivation of water-intensive crops like wheat and rice.
point1: Punjab has the highest percentage of over-exploited groundwater blocks among all Indian states at 76.47%.
point2: Heavy reliance on groundwater for cultivating wheat and rice has led to rising costs for deeper wells, land subsidence, and deteriorating water quality.

title: Canadian Minister Proposes New European Alliance with UK
summary: A Canadian minister has suggested that the UK and Canada should team up in a new European alliance. The proposal follows a suggestion by the European Commission President to open the door for Canada to become an associate member of the EU.
point1: A Canadian minister publicly proposed a new European alliance partnering Canada with the UK.
point2: The proposal comes after the European Commission President suggested making Canada an associate member of the EU.

title: CNN, MS NOW, and Politico to File Lawsuit Over Trump White House Ban
summary: US media outlets CNN, MS NOW, and Politico are filing a lawsuit against a White House ban imposed by Donald Trump. The outlets stated they are defending the principle that the government should not decide what the press reports.
point1: CNN, MS NOW, and Politico are jointly filing a lawsuit against the Trump administration's ban.
point2: The media organizations argue that the government cannot dictate what the press is allowed to report or publish.

title: Seven Ethiopian Rebel Groups Form New Alliance
summary: Seven rebel groups active in Ethiopia's most populous regions have announced the formation of a new alliance. The groups have pledged to work together after operating independently for years.
point1: The alliance consists of seven distinct rebel groups from Ethiopia's most populous regions.
point2: The groups intend to coordinate their activities and work together.

title: Space Probe BepiColombo Approaches Mercury After Eight-Year Journey
summary: The BepiColombo space probe is approaching Mercury after an eight-year journey through space. The probe is scheduled to begin studying Mercury's magnetic field and internal structure.
point1: BepiColombo has spent eight years in space traveling toward Mercury.
point2: The probe will investigate the planet's internal structure and magnetic field.
point3: The probe is scheduled to begin its scientific observations as it approaches the planet.

title: US and China Discuss AI Safety and National Security Threats Ahead of Summit
summary: Top U.S. and Chinese officials held talks in New York to discuss establishing a mechanism to notify each other of AI incidents that could threaten national security. The discussions took place ahead of an upcoming summit between Donald Trump and Xi Jinping.
point1: The talks in New York focused on setting up a mutual notification system for AI-related national security threats.
point2: The meeting serves as preparation for a scheduled summit between Donald Trump and Xi Jinping.
point3: The Trump-Xi summit is scheduled to take place this week.

title: Five Dead in Nilambur Flash Floods in Kerala
summary: Sudden flash floods in Nilambur, Kerala, swept away visitors along a riverbed, resulting in five confirmed fatalities. Emergency rescue personnel are conducting search operations to locate additional missing individuals.
point1: Five victims were recovered after sudden flash floods hit Nilambur in Kerala.
point2: Heavy localized rainfall triggered rapid flooding, trapping visitors along the river.
point3: Rescue teams continue search operations along the riverbed.

title: Google's Gemini AI Infiltrates Three Companies in Security Test
summary: Google reported that its Gemini AI system breached three corporate websites during controlled security tests by guessing credentials and browsing the web. Google confirmed the model immediately halted operations after gaining system access.
point1: Gemini AI successfully bypassed authentication protocols to access three external corporate targets in a test environment.
point2: The event highlights critical cyber capability developments and potential security risks in advanced AI models.
point3: Google reported that Gemini ceased testing actions immediately upon successfully breaching the systems.

title: Nato welcomes Greenland deal as Trump says it will give US 'permanent security control'
summary: Denmark and the United States have reached an agreement regarding Greenland following months of diplomatic pressure from Donald Trump. Trump stated the deal will provide the US with permanent security control, while NATO welcomed the strategic agreement.
point1: Denmark and the US agreed to terms regarding Greenland following extended negotiations.
point2: Establishes long-term security arrangements in the Arctic region supported by NATO.

title: Pakistani Authorities Arrest Sister of Former Prime Minister Imran Khan
summary: Police in Pakistan arrested Aleema Khanum, sister of jailed former Prime Minister Imran Khan. Law enforcement officials accused her of organizing opposition supporters ahead of planned nationwide political demonstrations.
point1: Aleema Khanum was taken into custody by Pakistani authorities.
point2: Escalates political friction between the ruling administration and supporters of Imran Khan's party.
